reviews.author: Michael Patterson
reviews.text: Reliable mechanics are a true God send. Now going on two generations of our family are so grateful to have the help of the Carpenter's service team.

reviews.author: Alyce-Hannah Golderer (Alyce WonderLand)
reviews.text: Fixed my SUV at a fantastic price, kept me informed on progress, and did not do anything without getting approval from me beforehand! Staff and mechanics are super nice, the whole place is very clean, and they don't try to talk you into anything you can't afford or don't need, plus, they made sure I was aware of any other issues with my ride before I left. Definitely check these folks out before you get your vehicle repaired anywhere else!!

reviews.author: Cyndy Anzek
reviews.text: Carpenter's is family owned and run. It is a down home grass roots salt of the earth kind of place you can take your vehicles to and know that you will be well taken care of. We continue going back not just because of the solid work they do but quite honestly because of the integrity of the owners and their team.

reviews.author: Najah Frazier
reviews.text: I dropped my car off on Monday to have an issue checked out and was told I’d receive a call later that day with an update. I didn’t hear back until two days later, when I was informed that the power steering pump I had purchased and had installed just four days prior was defective. While I understand this wasn’t your fault since your shop didn’t do the original install, I rightfully requested to keep my old part so I could return it. When I asked if my mom could pick it up, the front desk staff seemed annoyed and said they didn’t have time for her to retrieve the part or process a return. I then asked how much it would cost to have your shop take care of it instead. I was told it would be about $100 more, and I agreed…as long as I got my old part back. However, when I was informed my car was ready, I was told there would be an additional $80 charge due to a core fee that wasn’t mentioned before. So at that point, I either had to pay $80 more than expected, or allow the shop to keep a $300 part that I had explicitly asked to retain. That didn’t feel fair or transparent. I understand things come up, but clear communication and customer service are essential in any business, especially when customers are trusting you with something as important as their vehicle. I hope you’ll take this feedback seriously for the sake of improving future experiences.

reviews.author: Nick Battiste
reviews.text: My car needed to have a timing chain tensioner replaced. I brought the car to Carpenter’s. They looked at it and said the timing chain looked fine and that the solenoid needed to be replaced. After replacing it twice it still didn’t fix the issue. He set a diagnostic to run on my car for 2 weeks and I was advised to drive around so he could collect data. When I brought it back he said the engine was failing. The car died 2 months later. I had a different mechanic look at it after the car died and he told me the timing chain broke and I drove the car too long with it broken and that’s what caused the engine to fail. Carpenter’s are nice enough people but their misdiagnosis cost me $4000. Had they fixed what I asked them to in the first place, none of this would’ve happened and I’d have a working car. I do not recommend Carpenter’s Tire & Auto.

reviews.author: Lynda A. Lindsey
reviews.text: The staff knows what they need to do for your automobile and they do it. Ask them anything and only receive straight talk. Highly competitive prices

reviews.author: Tiffany Formby
reviews.text: Support local! I had a quickly deflating tire, which NTB quoted a 1.5hr wait and Costco a 2hr wait. Mr. Carpenter himself plugged the tire in about 10min for a very reasonable price. I’m forever grateful!

reviews.author: Kaitlyn Lowe
reviews.text: This shop was highly recommended to me. I also live within walking distance, so it made sense that I would take the day off of work to be able to drop my car off in the morning, walk home, then walk back to get it later in the day. First of all, they do not take appointments, so it's first come first serve. I took my car just for a diagnostic promptly at 8:00 AM, which I should add, none of the staff were even there when I got there. All seemed to be well, they took my key and said they would call me when they knew something. Great. I didn't hear anything, so I called close to 4:00 (they close at 5:00) and they said that they still had several cars ahead of me. If I got there right at 8:00 AM, wouldn't I be the first on the list? If that wasn't the case, I should have been told there's X amount of cars ahead of you, right? Maybe they are good at what they do but they certainly need to work on their communication and presentation (boxes, clutter everywhere in the office)

reviews.author: H Sinclair
reviews.text: Would NOT recommend. I took a vehicle there to repair and I clearly knew the problem and I explained it to the individual at the desk. I left the vehicle with them. I received a call later that nothing was wrong. I had the problem resolved elsewhere because the vehicle NEEDED REPAIR. It appears if they are too busy or just don’t want to help, they will brush off customers this way. This is the first and ONLY time I will be there.

reviews.author: Eric Dryer
reviews.text: SUPREMELY satisfied with my experience here. The staff was very courteous and engaging - they answered all of my questions and really inspired confidence in the quality of their work. I showed up first thing in the morning (8:00 AM) and was back on the road in just few hours with new rotors and pads installed. The price was a great value, too! I’ll be referring Carpenter’s to all of my friends and will certainly be a repeat customer.

reviews.author: Jason Giacomo
reviews.text: I was probably a "problem" customer with a terribly designed Jeep Renegade with phantom noises that came after getting struts replaced. I know the vehicle is not mechanic friendly, and neither was I. Frank and his crew still went out of their way to make sure I left happy. You won't beat their prices, just be patient, they are busier than Jesus responding to everyone's prayers.

reviews.author: Dondi Hydrick
reviews.text: I was headed back home passing through the CSRA when my truck broke down on I20 near Grovetown. I gave a wrecker come out and the driver suggested Carpenters to me when I asked for suggestions on a good honest auto shop. This is who he recommended, there are plenty of repair shops between Grovetown and North Augusta and the tow cost me more. But, I am glad that he suggested them and that I used them. They are friendly and HONEST people. They found the issue and fixed it right away at a fair price and honest price and that is from other mechanics I know back home. I recommend them to anyone needing a mechanic in that area. Thank you - Good honest people need to be recognized!!

reviews.author: Rachel Ratcliff
reviews.text: I've been going to them for over 25 years and they get it right every time! They are good, honest, caring people. Their prices are extremely reasonable and they don't try to sell you things you don't need. Frank and his staff do great work! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Sandi Emery
reviews.text: I went away from my first experience with his Auto place so excited and feeling Blessed. Frank quickly came to see how could help, so pleasant and quickly replaced my tire. I said my oil light was on could that be taken care of and he had that done efficiently so. Everyone there was very pleasant, I have been telling everyone since my need was handled and certainly didn’t take advantage of this widow lady. Prices so reasonable. THANKS CARPENTER FAMILY

reviews.author: Vaughn Robinson
reviews.text: Very nice people. They did some work on my truck. Very reasonable prices. I've been trying to go back by there and have them look at something else but, they have been so busy. No parking.

reviews.author: Kimberly D
reviews.text: Definitely want to help this place in the review department. VERY cost effective and honest. I have used them once, my parents have used them multiple times. They don't try to break your piggy bank and they don't try to upcharge or sell you services you don't need. They are even more cost effective if you can bring them the parts you need replaced. Great people. Always full and will always try to get you in as soon as they can. Highly recommended...and I do recommend them every chance I get. Well done Carpenter's!

reviews.author: Alyce WonderLand
reviews.text: These guys are ALWAYS polite and always do their very best to let you know precisely what the deal is with your ride. And, if there's a simpler, more affordable solution to a problem? They actually tell you that, ask you if you want them to go with that repair, and then they DON'T CHARGE YOU FOR REPAIRS YOU DON'T NEED!! Talk about a real difference from a lot of other auto repair establishments!!

reviews.author: Anna Mandell
reviews.text: I was stranded right up the street with a flat tire and caught the owner on his way out the door. He came to the rescue filling up my tire so I could get to getting it replaced! Thank you so much and for your father who served our country.

reviews.author: michael
reviews.text: My 2 vehicles mustang and van have been here over 2 years. I call all the time and its one excuse after the other. All the van needs is a fuel pump but they have yet to even touch it. The mustang needs a distributor and Holley sniper carb. This doesn't take 2 years. I get pissed every time I think about it. I just want my vehicles back. Now I bet there is a whole bunch of other problems with them since they've just been sitting while everyone else gets their cars worked on and I've been waiting.

reviews.author: Riv “Mic CHK one” Rivers
reviews.text: The folks at this shop did good work on my vehicle. I had been traveling between states (SC/GA);when my vehicle took a nose dive on the July 4th weekend. I called on BigTow wrecker service for transport and the driver suggested I try Carpenter’s. After the observation of the holiday on that Monday, I contacted the shop, to make them aware that I had my vehicle dropped off there. The people I had been in contact with were kind; they all told me that I’d be ready by the end of the week and that it would cost x amount for the repair but it would be dependent on a part that was not readily available(that part took 3 weeks from the time it was brought there). I’m happy with their work, but not with the time it took. Timing is everything I guess; at the end of the day you’ll be happy with this shop’s work.

reviews.author: koen kersbergen
reviews.text: Carpenters is a great place . I have known them for over 35 years . I remember that place when they still had their little shop across the street from the Wafflehouse on Georgia Ave. The owner Keith and his son Frank are laid back and always treat you well .

reviews.author: Joel Rosario
reviews.text: Excellent service. It feels like they actually care and are a trustworthy mechanic shop. Won’t go anywhere else. Thank you to Sarah and the team at Carpenters.

reviews.author: Lindsey Finocchiaro
reviews.text: Always upfront with their prices. I don't like the woman they have answering the phones. She can be quite rude. Other than that, the mechanics are great at explaining what needs to get done and they are very reasonable with their prices for parts and labor.

reviews.author: Terry Dearman
reviews.text: If you need a good shop to go to try Carpenters tire and oil, I had to have a water pump replaced. I dropped it off last night for them to fix it today, and by 2 pm I received a call telling me my repairs were finished and the price was very reasonable. And very honest people.

reviews.author: Mary Jennings
reviews.text: First of all the people was very friendly, beautiful personality. Did good work on my car. Told me if I had any problems come back. Very pleased.

reviews.author: Tripp Courtney
reviews.text: This was my 4th time there and I don't plan on going anywhere else. It seemed everywhere else they never got it right the first time. Frank at Carpenter's is 4-4 and counting and all 4 times it took less than a day to jobs that took at least 2 days at othe places. In addition the lady who handles the administrative side of things is very friendly and communicates with customers to get you options and then informs u when your vehicle is ready.... I am hard to please I am embarassed to say but this business gets A's across the board except for front parking ....but thats a small thing. If you live in downtown Augusta or in north Augusta and you go anywhere else you are making a mistake.

reviews.author: Katherine Maeve
reviews.text: They've all been so nice to me when I've had weirdness in my car. And, they're just generally nice, I never need to worry, everything has always come out A-OK

reviews.author: Arthur Ivey
reviews.text: In 2020, you need good people with you. Carpenter's my people. Frank and the crew great work and friendly. The young LADY upfront smiling and welcoming. All with working man pricing.

reviews.author: Brent Croft
reviews.text: These guys were amazing! I had some issues with my truck and everyone was so helpful. They were able to get me in and get me out quickly so I could return to work.

reviews.author: Laura Garner
reviews.text: I took my car in for a tuneup recently and experienced great service with a reasonable price to match. They were timely, friendly, professional and my car has never run better!

reviews.author: rebecca evans
reviews.text: They worked really hard to figure out the issue with our vehicle. Our car was a problem car and I'm sure it was irritating them, both finding the issue and my constant calls, but they were very patient and treated us well!

reviews.author: Jaime Jackson
reviews.text: Great place had brakes done. After 2weeks heard a rubbing sound they checked it over had the car 2days. Gave it back NO extra charge.

reviews.author: Decorah Monroe
reviews.text: I rate these folks/business an excellent place to service my car. Very efficient service and kind pleasant employees. It's the only place I take my car.

reviews.author: Peter Bernhardt
reviews.text: Carpenters took care of my needs in an expedient fashion, charged minimally for labor , and stayed open past their normal hours just to get me fixed up that day when they could have told me to come back the next day. Would use again.

reviews.author: Carolyn Henson
reviews.text: Just thankful they were there to help me out. Had a problem with a tire. Was able to get one and install it same day. Thanks!

reviews.author: St Simon
reviews.text: A good asset to North Augusta community. The family has run this establishment for many years and always give their best.

reviews.author: Sabrina Lynch
reviews.text: I called with a question about my vehicle & the owner answered, and said they take diesels. Then in the middle of me talking to lady who takes calls takes the phone from him interrupting me. Then says they don’t take diesels & she knows because she’s the one who takes vehicles. Very rude & unprofessional. So if you have a diesel don’t waste your time.

reviews.author: Nichole Johnson
reviews.text: The best service ever. Everyone from the front desk, the mechanics, and the owners are exceptionally genuine on top of the great job they do.

reviews.author: Laura
reviews.text: The whole Carpenters Tires was Awesome!! Thank you guys yall saved my day. Pluged my tire from the inside, and I was on my way. Thank you guys and gals so much. You helped me so extremely much for the rest of my day. #shoplocal #northaugusta @ #Carpenter'sTires

reviews.author: Ken Kehr
reviews.text: I wouldn't let anyone else work on my cars. Reliable and honest maintenance and repairs with fair prices. Don't go anywhere else

reviews.author: Matthew Gomez
reviews.text: Honest and dependable. They will not do work unnecessarily just to get more money. Great people to work with!

reviews.author: Visa Bauknight
reviews.text: Carpenters are wonderful people. It doesn't matter how busy and overwhelming this shop gets they are friendly and make sure the job gets done.

reviews.author: Dorothy Rotan
reviews.text: We have always used Carpenter's. Very dependable and reasonable. No matter what the problem, they take of it for us.

reviews.author: Anthony
reviews.text: Fast and courteous service, at fair and honest prices. Proud to support such a reputable local business!

reviews.author: Ian Templeman
reviews.text: This is the only shop that will touch my vehicles! Im very picky about work and they an amazing job on my yukon!
